note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 28 November 2026, RealHunt lists 4 homes for sale in Uruguay, each one checked by a person.
In Uruguay, the median asking price of those 4 homes is €180,300 (€1,649 per m², from the 4 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €150,300 and the most expensive €186,300.
Taxes and fees add about 5–8% to the price of a home in Uruguay (figures as of 2026).
With 4 homes this is a small sample, so the median for Uruguay is a rough guide.

buying.costs_breakdown: Transfer tax (ITP) of 2% for the buyer and 2% for the seller, on the cadastral value (valor real) set by the Dirección Nacional de Catastro; notary fees of about 3%; and an agent's fee of about 3%.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes. There are no limits on the types of property foreign buyers can purchase in Uruguay, and they have the same property rights as citizens.

homes.title: Brick chalet with three bedrooms one block from the beach in La Aguada, La Paloma
homes.title_es: Chalet de ladrillo con tres dormitorios a una manzana de la playa en La Aguada, La Paloma
homes.summary: Asking US$165,000 (about €150,300). A solidly built single-storey chalet of exposed brick in La Aguada, next to La Paloma, one block from the beach, less than 100 m from the sea and with a sea view listed in the advert. 100 m² on a 450 m² corner plot facing two streets, with gardens front and back. A bright living and dining room with big windows is partly open to the kitchen, and a corridor leads to three bedrooms with built-in shelves and two refurbished shower rooms with glass screens. There is a garage, a tiled patio and a covered barbecue. Listed in good condition, built more than 30 years ago.

homes.title: Timber-ceiling house with fireplace and barbecue under 100 m from the sea, Playa Grande
homes.title_es: Casa de techo de madera con chimenea y barbacoa a menos de 100 m del mar, Playa Grande
homes.summary: Asking US$198,000 (about €180,300). A traditional house of 115 m² in Playa Grande, next to Piriápolis, less than 100 m from the coast road and the sea. Inside are timber beam ceilings and terracotta floors, a large living room with a wood fire, a dining room, a separate kitchen, two bedrooms (one en suite), two full bathrooms and an attic room upstairs. Outside are front and back gardens, a large covered barbecue area and a garage. The house is fully independent but held under a horizontal property title on a plot of almost 400 m² for its exclusive use.

homes.title: Recently built three-bed house three blocks from the beach in La Paloma, Rocha
homes.title_es: Casa de tres dormitorios recién construida a tres manzanas de la playa en La Paloma, Rocha
homes.summary: Asking US$165,000 (about €150,300). A recently built single-storey house, 1 to 8 years old and listed in excellent condition, on a quiet street in the Playa Serena area of La Paloma, about 300 m from the beach. It has a bright open living, dining and kitchen space, three bedrooms (one en suite) and a second full bathroom. Outside there is a timber deck with a covered barbecue, a fully fenced 510 m² garden among pines and a parking space. Sold directly by the owner, and the photos show a clean, modern finish throughout.

homes.title: Three-bedroom house with a barbecue patio near the rambla in Colonia del Sacramento
homes.title_es: Casa de tres dormitorios con patio de barbacoa cerca de la rambla en Colonia del Sacramento
homes.summary: Asking US$205,000 (about €186,300) for a single-storey brick house of 113 m² on a 475 m² plot in Colonia del Sacramento, the old Portuguese riverside town facing Buenos Aires. The advert puts it 300 metres from the Rambla Costanera and a short distance from the old town. It has three bedrooms, two full bathrooms, a modern kitchen open to the living and dining room, air conditioning in the living room and main bedroom, a garage and a private patio with a built-in barbecue. The back garden is large and green. It is described as in excellent condition and ready to live in.
